item.title: Fund administrator system maintenance is scheduled: says Nasfund
item.description: MEMBERS of major superannuation fund Nasfund have experienced delayed in the superannuation fund’s systems and have queried that an outage has been experienced since Friday and even today. item.description: The Papua New Guinea women’s national football team, the PNG Bilums, departed today for Fiji to compete in the second round of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Oceania Qualifiers. item.title: Collapsed bridge disrupts travel and commerce in Bogia District
item.description: Travel and trade in Bogia District have been severely disrupted after a section of the Kumil Bridge along the Madang–Bogia Highway collapsed, leaving commuters and traders struggling to cross the river. The disruption is affecting not only the people of Bogia but also travellers from Middle Ramu, East Sepik and West Sepik provinces who rely on the highway.
